title: Define configuration schema for LICHEN group/realm to IRC channel mapping
description: Define a configuration schema that maps LICHEN groups/realms to IRC channels. The schema should support: IRC server connection details (host, port, TLS, nick, password), channel-to-group mappings (IRC channel -> LICHEN group/realm), authorization rules (which IRC nicks/hostmasks can send to LICHEN), rate limit parameters, queue bounds, and store-and-forward settings. Use Pydantic or similar for validation. Configuration should be loadable from YAML/JSON files with secrets kept in protected runtime config.
